---
title: "IPCEI DiD --- Technology-tagged composition, entropy balancing"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(did)
library(dplyr)
source("_cs_helpers.R")
set.seed(42)
BSTRAP <- FALSE   # analytic/agg-bootstrap SEs for a fast exploratory pass; set TRUE for final
```

Entropy-balancing robustness for the technology-tagged composition outcomes
(and the consortium-size mechanism). Controls reweighted so weighted covariate
means match the treated means (`weightsname = "w"`). One panel per technology.
Mirrors `07_..._psm.Rmd`; outputs to
`results/ebal/composition_techtagged/month/`.

```{r paths}
PATH_BATTERY  <- "../data/battery_ebal_cs_ready.csv"
PATH_HYDROGEN <- "../data/hydrogen_ebal_cs_ready.csv"
OUT_DIR       <- "../results/ebal/composition_techtagged/month"
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

WEIGHTS   <- "w"
XFORMLA   <- NULL
BITERS    <- 999
```

```{r load}
battery  <- load_cs(PATH_BATTERY)
hydrogen <- load_cs(PATH_HYDROGEN)
```

```{r estimate}
rows <- list(); es <- list()

for (key in names(outcome_map)) {
  for (tech in c("battery", "hydrogen")) {
    df    <- if (tech == "battery") battery else hydrogen
    yname <- outcome_map[[key]][[tech]]
    if (!(yname %in% names(df))) next
    cs <- run_cs(df, yname, label = paste("ebal", key, tech),
                 xformla = XFORMLA, control_group = cg_for(tech),
                 weightsname = WEIGHTS, biters = BITERS, bstrap = BSTRAP)
    rows[[paste(key, tech)]] <- make_att_row_std(
      agg_simple(cs, BSTRAP), tools::toTitleCase(tech), outcome_labels[[key]],
      outcome_type[[key]], cs_out = cs, df = df, yname = yname)
    es[[paste(key, tech)]] <- es_frame(cs, tools::toTitleCase(tech), outcome_labels[[key]], BSTRAP)
  }
}

# Consortium size (level outcome; no log transform)
for (tech in c("battery", "hydrogen")) {
  df <- if (tech == "battery") battery else hydrogen
  if (!("mean_collab_size" %in% names(df))) next
  cs <- run_cs(df, "mean_collab_size", label = paste("ebal consortium", tech),
               xformla = XFORMLA, control_group = cg_for(tech),
               weightsname = WEIGHTS, biters = BITERS, bstrap = BSTRAP)
  rows[[paste("consortium", tech)]] <- make_att_row_std(
    agg_simple(cs, BSTRAP), tools::toTitleCase(tech),
    "Consortium size (mean firms/collab)", "Mechanism",
    cs_out = cs, df = df, yname = "mean_collab_size")
  es[[paste("consortium", tech)]] <- es_frame(
    cs, tools::toTitleCase(tech), "Consortium size (mean firms/collab)", BSTRAP)
}

att <- do.call(rbind, rows)
write.csv(att, file.path(OUT_DIR, "att_techtagged_table.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
esdf <- do.call(rbind, es)
if (!is.null(esdf))
  write.csv(esdf, file.path(OUT_DIR, "event_study_techtagged.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cons <- att[att$Outcome == "Consortium size (mean firms/collab)", ]
if (nrow(cons))
  write.csv(cons, file.path(OUT_DIR, "consortium_size_att.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(att)
```
